name: ReleaseOrder
description: Approve and release a pending sales order in the SAP ERP system. Trigger this function when the user explicitly requests to approve, release, sign off, or authorize a sales order.

order_id.description: The unique sales order identifier in SAP (e.g., 'ORD-20240001') that needs approval and release.

comment.description: An optional note, remark, or justification explaining the reason for approving and releasing the order.
